3b98edaf2ecfe8dd.what: Presents an ML framework (Random Forest, XGBoost, neural network, plus SISSO symbolic regression) for predicting zT of half-Heusler compounds, using a PCA-based train/test split to test on unseen compositions.
3b98edaf2ecfe8dd.why: Many thermoelectric ML models generalize poorly to new chemistries.
3b98edaf2ecfe8dd.how: Bayesian hyperparameter optimization with correlation-based k-best feature selection (test RMSE reduced 16-27% vs. all 118 features); SHAP and SISSO for interpretation; first-principles checks on CeCoBi and CeIrBi; screening of about 2.46 million doped substitutions over 631 parent matrices.
3b98edaf2ecfe8dd.impact: Low relevance to the GaN, InGaAs and BAs projects, since it targets electronic zT rather than phonon transport. The PCA-based splitting for out-of-distribution testing and the feature-importance analysis could loosely inform MLIP data-efficiency and failure-mode studies.

05d2d00766412b4d.what: First-principles, BTE and dual-phonon-theory study of the Zintl phase KCaBi, finding very low out-of-plane κL (about 0.15-0.27 W/m/K at 700 K) and p-type in-plane ZT of about 2.3-2.5.
05d2d00766412b4d.why: Zintl phases are promising thermoelectrics, and the link between bonding heterogeneity and low κL needs to be understood.
05d2d00766412b4d.how: DFT, phonon BTE, and dual-phonon theory covering both propagating phonons and diffuson-like transport; results reported under two criteria (Crit. I and Crit. III).
05d2d00766412b4d.impact: Relevant methodologically: it combines BTE with a diffuson/crossover treatment for strongly anharmonic, rattling-like systems, which relates to the BTE and lattice-dynamics side of the BAs and InGaAs work. The material is not one of the reader's projects.

d45d1c092a1d5c75.what: Experimental study of mechanochemically synthesized Cs3Bi2Br9 and Cs3Bi2Br6I3: synchrotron diffraction, Raman/IR phonons checked against DFT lattice dynamics, low thermal conductivity (about 0.15-0.25 W/m/K), optical gaps, and photocatalytic dye degradation.
d45d1c092a1d5c75.why: Seeks lead-free halide perovskite alternatives that combine optical, thermal and catalytic function.
d45d1c092a1d5c75.how: Synchrotron diffraction with a site-resolved Debye model, Raman/IR with group theory, DFT lattice dynamics, and photocatalysis tests on Rhodamine B.
d45d1c092a1d5c75.impact: Low relevance. It is mostly experimental and none of the projects uses this material. Only the DFT lattice-dynamics validation of the measured phonons is loosely transferable.

7743e207ad355284.what: First-principles plus CGCNN study of gas adsorption (NH3, CO2, H2, H2O, O2, NO2, CO, SO2) on a Na-decorated GaP/silicene heterostructure, covering optical, thermoelectric and mechanical responses.
7743e207ad355284.why: Seeks heterostructures for selective gas sensing and thermoelectric applications.
7743e207ad355284.how: DFT calculations combined with CGCNN predictions of elastic moduli, Debye temperature and thermal expansion.
7743e207ad355284.impact: Low relevance. It concerns gas sensing, not phonon transport or interfaces in the reader's projects.

1a9ac75f4016f820.what: Large-scale MD of GaN crystallization on a twinned AlN/GaN configuration versus an untwinned cubic reference at 1700-2500 K, quantifying ordering and cubic-hexagonal competition.
1a9ac75f4016f820.why: Interfacial defects such as AlN twins degrade GaN epitaxial quality for power electronics.
1a9ac75f4016f820.how: MD runs of 3 ns with four velocity seeds per temperature; structural transition matrices track ordering (twinned system's mean ordered fraction rose from 13.44% at 1700 K to 68.34% at 2500 K).
1a9ac75f4016f820.impact: Related to the GaN/AlGaN HEMT and GaN/Al2O3 interface projects as a source of interface structure and defect context. It does not address thermal transport, and its force field is Not stated in the abstract.

3885ea43f5c33a7d.what: Computational study of double half-Heusler compounds X2FeNiZ2 (X = Ti, Zr, Hf; Z = Sb, Bi) following the 18-electron rule, with 20-40% lower lattice thermal conductivity than ternary half-Heuslers.
3885ea43f5c33a7d.why: Cobalt-based 18-electron half-Heuslers have good electronic properties but high lattice thermal conductivity.
3885ea43f5c33a7d.how: First-principles calculations of lattice thermal conductivity and band structure; the reduction is attributed to heterogeneous strong/weak bonding that enhances anharmonicity and phonon scattering.
3885ea43f5c33a7d.impact: Low-moderate relevance. It is a phonon and anharmonicity analysis in a material outside the reader's projects, but the bonding-heterogeneity argument is a useful reference for interpreting κ in alloys such as InGaAs.

c80295cd67710499.what: Perspective on ten representative 2024-2025 advances in AI agents for science, spanning general agent architectures, chemistry, materials science, energy systems and security governance.
c80295cd67710499.why: AI agents are moving from chat assistants to integrated scientific operating layers that plan, use tools, and revise.
c80295cd67710499.how: Selection by four criteria: scientific significance, agentic functionality, cross-domain representation, and demonstrated progress. Specific systems are Not stated in the abstract.
c80295cd67710499.impact: Background reading for agents and automated workflows for first-principles and lattice-dynamics calculations, for example around MLPhonon. It is a broad overview, so likely little technical detail.

f413a56dc8518ff2.what: Release v4.11.0 of phono3py, merged from the release pull request #669.
f413a56dc8518ff2.how: Not stated in the abstract; the changelog is not provided.
f413a56dc8518ff2.impact: phono3py is a core tool for the reader's lattice-dynamics and BTE workflows (GaN, InGaAs, BAs, MLPhonon). Check the release notes for changes affecting MLIP-driven force-constant workflows before upgrading.

2b4e571a6b437e0a.what: metatrain, an open-source Python/torch repository from the metatensor group for training, fine-tuning and manipulating machine-learning models for atomistic systems.
2b4e571a6b437e0a.why: Provides a common framework for atomistic ML models.
2b4e571a6b437e0a.how: Python on torch. Supported architectures and interfaces are Not stated in the abstract.
2b4e571a6b437e0a.impact: Potentially useful as an MLIP training and fine-tuning framework next to DeePMD-kit and MACE in the InGaAs, GaN/AlGaN and BAs pipelines, and for comparing MLIPs. Compatibility with LAMMPS and phonopy workflows needs checking.

034946a1a6a01abc.what: VOTCA, the C++ source for the votca-csg and xtp packages (coarse-graining, GROMACS, GW-BSE, charge transport, multiscale simulation).
034946a1a6a01abc.why: Provides multiscale tools linking molecular dynamics, coarse-graining and excited-state/charge-transport calculations.
034946a1a6a01abc.how: C++ code base; details are Not stated in the abstract.
034946a1a6a01abc.impact: Low relevance. It targets soft-matter coarse-graining and organic charge transport, not phonon transport in the reader's semiconductors.

2f128441e10a48d8.what: A GROMACS molecular dynamics tutorial repository covering protein-ligand, lipid bilayer and free-energy examples.
2f128441e10a48d8.why: Teaches molecular dynamics simulation with self-explained material.
2f128441e10a48d8.how: Shell scripts and tutorials on GROMACS and CHARMM; details are Not stated in the abstract.
2f128441e10a48d8.impact: Low relevance. It is biomolecular MD, whereas the projects use LAMMPS and MLIPs for crystalline semiconductors.
